parsed_response.rationale:
The current low-level goals (LLGs) cover the essential aspects of centralizing hospital administration, including registration, configuration, updates, deletion, and real-time monitoring. Each LLG is supported by a documented functional interaction or effect, aligning with the parent goal's description. There are no unsupported or misleading LLGs, nor any missing essential capabilities.

The 'Register Hospital in System' (llg_001) corresponds to the registration of new hospital entities into the system with required metadata.
The 'Configure Hospital Settings' (llg_002) aligns with configuring hospital-specific settings such as contact info, operating hours, and departmental structure.
The 'Update Hospital Information' (llg_003) matches modifying existing hospital metadata like address, contact details, or operational status.
The 'Delete Hospital from System' (llg_004) corresponds to removing a hospital entity from the system, including associated metadata and configurations.
The 'Monitor Hospital Status' (llg_005) supports real-time operational status viewing, including active/inactive status, resource availability, and performance metrics.

All LLGs are non-redundant, supported by documentary evidence, and fall within the scope of the parent goal. No regeneration is required as all essential capabilities are covered.
